title: Ohuhu refund policy
content: Refunds under 50 USD can be auto-approved after order verification. Refunds above 50 USD require manual approval.

title: Ohuhu delivery claim handling
content: If tracking shows delivered and proof exists, ask the customer to verify the address, mailbox, neighbors, and reception before opening a claim.

title: Ohuhu marker nib compatibility
content: The Brush Replacement Nib Pack is compatible with the Ohuhu Marker Set 48 and the Honolulu series.

title: Ohuhu watercolor recommendation
content: For watercolor-style sketching, recommend the Ohuhu Watercolor Pad and the Watercolor Brush Pen Set 24.

title: Tribit warranty policy
content: Tribit speakers include a 12-month warranty from delivery date for manufacturing defects.

title: Tribit XSound Go Bluetooth version
content: Tribit XSound Go supports Bluetooth 5.3 and stereo pairing.

title: Tribit exchange policy
content: An exchange can be created only after the target SKU is confirmed in stock.

title: General support reply guidance
content: Use short paragraphs, mention the verified facts first, and end with the next step.
